newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firmer in Moscow in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firmer in Moscow in thin trade.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds edged up on Monday on speculative demand from Moscow in otherwise thin trade due to the Martin Luther King Day holiday in the United States.
The sixth and seventh tranches are illiquid among Moscow traders.
"Prices firmed in the morning but then edged down as London stepped in. There is nothing going on now as foreigners have already left the market," Avtobank dealer Alla Zakharova said.
Dealers said rare speculative transactions were all that drove today's price changes.
